headlines.title: Has cyclospora outbreak peaked? There are promising signs in Michigan after lettuce recall.
headlines.description: There are promising signs that illnesses linked to contaminated lettuce may be slowing in Michigan, the hotspot of the multistate outbreak of cyclosporiasis in the U.S.

headlines.title: How the Cyclosporiasis Outbreak is Hitting Restaurants and Stores
headlines.description: As the multi-state cyclosporiasis outbreak continues to grow, more Americans are shifting their restaurant and grocery shopping habits as a precaution. Four in ten people say they are now buying or eating less produce due to the outbreak, according to a new survey. NBC’s Jesse Kirsch reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: American surgeon restores sight to thousands at war-torn border of South Sudan
headlines.description: An American eye surgeon and his team performed over 1,000 cataract surgeries in Abyei along the South Sudan border, restoring sight to thousands in a region with one of the world's highest blindness rates. NBC News' Molly Hunter reports.

headlines.title: How to Enjoy Summer Foods Safely Amid Outbreaks and Recalls
headlines.description: From the ongoing parasite outbreak linked to lettuce to food recalls and more, Women’s Health dietitian Valerie Agyeman joins TODAY with tips to enjoying summer foods safely. She breaks down the proper way to clean and store produce, how long food can stay out in the summer heat, how to keep water bottles free of bacteria, and more.

headlines.title: Skin Care by the Decade: How to Adapt Your Routine as You Age
headlines.description: Experts say it’s important to adjust your skin care routine as you age so TODAY contributor and board-certified dermatologist Dr. Michelle Henry breaks down what you should be doing in your 20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, 60s and beyond. She also explains how your skin changes over the decades and why it's important to be strategic about the ingredients you use at each phase of life.

headlines.title: The best editor-approved meat delivery services in 2026
headlines.description: We tested steak, chicken, seafood and more from brands like Omaha Steaks, Butcherbox, and Lobsterboys to see which has the best meat delivery service for your next BBQ.

headlines.title: Do you really need sunscreen for your hair? I asked dermatologists and hair care experts
headlines.description: I asked dermatologists about whether you need sunscreen for your hair and rounded up the best ones to shop. Browse hair SPFs from brands like Coola, Pantene, Sun Bum and more.

headlines.title: These popular backpacks are functional, stylish and up to 71% off just in time for back-to-school shopping
headlines.description: Ahead of back-to-school season, retailers are discounting classroom-ready backpacks that work just as well for commuting or weekend travel. Get Coach, Calpak, Herschel and more up to 71% off

headlines.title: How to prevent boob sweat, according to experts
headlines.description: Beyond making you uncomfortable, boob sweat can cause painful sweat rashes under the breasts. Experts share the best boob sweat solutions and how to treat intertrigo.

headlines.title: How the cyclospora lettuce outbreak sparked a massive consumer trust crisis
headlines.description: The cyclospora outbreak has people avoiding salads and burrito bowls. Now, for many Americans the question is whether any lettuce can be trusted.

headlines.title: Map: Track the spread of measles in the U.S.
headlines.description: NBC News is tracking confirmed measles case counts and state infection tallies. This data will be updated regularly.

headlines.title: U.S. measles cases reach 35-year high in 2026, surpassing last year’s total
headlines.description: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reported Friday that the United States has logged 2,318 measles cases in the first seven months of this year, surpassing last year’s total of 2,289.
